name: jd-search
title: JD Search
description: Search every Johnny.Decimal system jd knows about, across the vault and the filesystem at once
author: moriarty2302

preferences.name: jdConfigPath
preferences.title: jd config file
preferences.description: Leave blank to ask jd where its config is (jd paths), or ~/.config/johnnydecimal/config.json without jd

preferences.name: folderNotes
preferences.title: Folder notes
preferences.label: Put new notes in a same-named folder
preferences.description: jd makes a bare note (W0033~21.25 Title.md). Turn this on if your vault keeps each note in a folder of the same name, and the note is moved there after jd makes it.

commands.name: search
commands.title: Search Johnny.Decimal
commands.description: Find an ID, category, area or work package by number or by words, and open its note or folder.

commands.name: new-work-package
commands.title: New Work Package
commands.description: Make a work package with jd: the next W number, its note, folder and task project.

scripts.publish: echo 'Private extension: not for the Raycast Store' && exit 1
